related_resources.reason: Records households and property in seventeen localities near Tepetlaoztoc, likely made around 1539–43; early colonial records cannot be used as direct census of 1490.
Collection record describes households, names, villages, parcels and taxation context; its claim of Spanish authorship is not adopted over manuscript specialists.
Identifies household-census, parcel measurement and computed area registers in Santa María Asunción and Vergara.
Compares depicted field areas, dimensions and geometrical estimates; three quarters of reported areas within 5 percent of theoretical maxima under specified modeling assumptions.
Preserves context of five pictorial manuscripts, including preconquest and colonial examples; survival sample is highly selective.
Supplementary orientation only, not used to substantiate historical claims.
